research.name: Adversary Emulation & Detection Lab
research.oneLiner: Simulated attacks + custom detections across MITRE ATT&CK.
research.description: Simulated 10+ MITRE ATT&CK techniques across Discovery, Persistence, Lateral Movement, and Collection on Windows and Linux hosts. Collected endpoint telemetry with Wazuh and Elastic, then authored 10+ custom Sigma rules mapped to technique IDs. Validated detection logic against generated telemetry to connect offensive actions to analyst response.
research.visualTheme: SOC alerts, kill chain, detection coverage

research.name: VulnSwarm-VEX
research.oneLiner: Deterministic dependency vulnerability triage with VEX verdicts.
research.description: Turns OSV advisories into affected / not_affected / manual_review VEX-style verdicts using application-specific evidence. Uses Z3 for selected checks and keeps LLMs confined to reviewer notes. Paper under review.
research.visualTheme: Dependency graph / network nodes — evidence flowing into verdict decisions

research.name: Acctomatic
research.oneLiner: Agentic document automation for accounting firms.
research.description: Acctomatic ingests invoices and extracts structured fields using local OCR and vision models, flags uncertain items for review, and exports validated data into accounting-system formats. It is built around a multi-tenant architecture with a GREEN/RED validation state machine and a pluggable extraction pipeline designed to keep bookkeepers in the loop.
research.visualTheme: Documents / invoices — structured extraction, automation pipeline

research.name: AI Outfit Recommender
research.oneLiner: ML outfit recommendations from clothing attributes.
research.description: Built a machine learning recommender that suggests outfits by matching clothing attributes to occasion, season and user preferences. Ranked top-N combinations and evaluated results under sparse-data conditions.

research.name: Eleventh Round
research.oneLiner: Career infrastructure platform for combat sports.
research.description: Paid Buildora client engagement building a cinematic career platform for fighters, managers, and promotions. Delivered role-specific dashboards, a podcast section, and apparel integration using React, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind. Motion work includes GSAP, Framer Motion, Lenis, and Three.js for an Awwwards-quality scroll-driven experience.
research.visualTheme: Cinematic combat sports — bold motion, high contrast

research.name: Buildora Agent Pipeline
research.oneLiner: 12-agent LangGraph pipeline for lead gen and outreach.
research.description: Replaced a no-code lead-gen workflow with a 12-agent LangGraph pipeline that automates lead generation, site building, video pitch creation, and cold outreach. Agents are orchestrated through a real-time Next.js dashboard an operator can monitor and interrupt. The system combines web scraping, browser automation, LLM reasoning, and email orchestration into one autonomous workflow.
research.visualTheme: Agents / pipeline — graph of autonomous workers

research.name: A Voice Made of Blinks
research.oneLiner: Webcam blink interface for nonverbal ICU patients.
research.description: Built at the Claude Life Sciences hackathon, this project gives nonverbal ICU patients a way to communicate through real-time webcam blink detection. It pairs switch-scanning selection with per-patient scan-speed calibration and adaptive need-list reordering. This is a hackathon prototype, not a medical device.

research.name: Prompt Optimiser
research.oneLiner: Production browser extension with a 6-stage AI pipeline.
research.description: A Chrome/Edge extension that injects a real-time Optimize button into ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, scrapes the current prompt plus the last two conversation turns for context, and runs a 6-stage classification and rewrite pipeline through the Groq API before replacing the user's text in-place. The Manifest V3 extension uses a background service worker to bypass CORS, stores the Groq API key locally, and ships with per-site DOM adapters and a popup configuration UI.
research.visualTheme: Browser extension with a flowing stage pipeline

research.name: TinyVulnScanner
research.oneLiner: Multithreaded Python vulnerability scanner with 500+ concurrent ports.
research.description: Lightweight multithreaded Python vulnerability scanner bundled with a demo lab and modular checks. It combines fast TCP port discovery with banner grabbing, security-header checks, reflected XSS and boolean-based SQLi tests, plus TLS/SSH inspection, producing severity-rated HTML/JSON reports. The scanner probes 500+ ports concurrently and runs about 70% faster than a sequential scan.

research.name: Android App
research.oneLiner: Android app built in Java after high school CS.
research.description: Built an Android application in Java after learning the language in high school computer science. The project was a hands-on way to apply object-oriented programming and mobile-development fundamentals as a solo developer.

EDUAI ingests course and task data through the Canvas LMS API, then applies predictive scheduling to estimate effort and distribute daily and weekly study time. It balances deadlines, difficulty, workload, and availability, with documented limits around subjective workload labels and sparse data.
research.name: EDUAI
research.oneLiner: AI study scheduler using Canvas LMS data.

research.name: BillShield
research.oneLiner: Healthcare billing dispute and workflow automation.
research.description: BillShield is a Vite-based React frontend with Tailwind CSS and a server folder backend built for healthcare billing disputes and workflow automation. It includes dashboard UX, dispute-management flows, patient-facing communication concepts, and a PRD for an AI-powered medical billing integrity platform.
research.visualTheme: Healthcare / billing — clean forms, dispute flow

research.name: Crypton
research.oneLiner: Zero-trust cryptographic identity and trusted-device auth.
research.description: Crypton is a zero-trust hardware device identity and authentication infrastructure. I co-founded it and lead technical direction across a monorepo that pairs a Rust/Axum backend trust engine with Redis/PostgreSQL, an SDK-first enrollment flow, WebAuthn/passkey support, JWT session management, and an admin panel for audit logs, security policies and device revocation. The platform is in early access with about 10 beta users.
research.visualTheme: Cryptographic identity — keys, trust rings, device verification

research.name: Proto Paper
research.oneLiner: Turns research PDFs into runnable experiment guides.
research.description: A full-stack hackathon tool that ingests research papers via PDF upload, URL, or pasted text and uses the Groq API (Llama 3.3 70B) to generate experiment checklists, seeding plans, pseudocode, and runnable code scaffolds. I led the frontend in Next.js 16, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS and contributed to the backend generation pipeline, including JSON schema validation, quality scoring, and automatic retries.
